IO3_transformations.algorithm: Find groups whose geometry contains user's location. Verify 10+ members. Rank by: (1/distance) * (relevance)
IO3_transformations.accuracy_target: All nearby groups returned, ranked by relevance

IO3_transformations.algorithm: Match user's children's school enrollment to parent-community groups. Create groups if needed.
IO3_transformations.accuracy_target: 100% correct school match, groups created with principal as admin

IO3_transformations.algorithm: Score = proximity * fuel_type_match * wind_corridor_overlap * insurance_tier. Find groups scoring >threshold.
IO3_transformations.accuracy_target: Rank groups by shared wildfire risk

IO3_transformations.algorithm: Match users in evacuation zone. Group by vehicle availability. Assign driver/passenger roles. Calculate route.
IO3_transformations.accuracy_target: All evacuation-zone users in convoy. No single-person convoys. Roles assigned by vehicle capacity.

DW1_upstream_pipeline.description: Census tracts, fire districts, school enrollments, hazard zones available
DW1_upstream_pipeline.data_format: geo boundaries, school IDs, hazard polygons

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: User matched to candidate group types (neighborhood, parent-community, burn-together)
Candidate groups ranked by relevance. Neighborhood > burn-together > parent-community (in terms of discovery relevance).
If no matching group exists and threshold met: create neighborhood or parent-community group
Suggestions shown in group discovery UI
On emergency event: create evacuation convoys for affected users

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Group suggestion algorithm latency (spatial queries + ranking). Burn-together scoring (complex algorithm with external data). Evacuation convoy creation (fan-out to all affected users). Auto-group creation (parent-community groups at scale).
P.P2_defensibility: Neighborhood groups driven by real geo boundaries (census, fire district). Parent-community groups auto-create via school enrollment (removes manual overhead). Burn-together algorithm uses real hazard data (fuel, wind). Evacuation convoys auto-generated (no manual coordination needed).
P.P3_confidence_level: Very high confidence in neighborhood group matching (deterministic). High confidence in parent-community matching (school enrollment is definitive). Medium confidence in burn-together algorithm (tuning needed with fire department). Medium confidence in evacuation convoy generation (new workflow, field testing needed).
P4_failure_modes: No matching group found → user sees empty suggestions (mitigate: show 'no groups nearby, start one' with create button)
Too many suggestions → user overwhelmed (mitigate: limit to top 5, show why suggested)
Geo boundary incorrect or missing (e.g., fire district not in system) → users not matched (mitigate: fallback to 10-mile radius search)
School enrollment data not available → parent-community groups not suggested (mitigate: user can create manually)
Evacuation convoy creation fails → users in evacuation zone not grouped (mitigate: retry, alert admins, users can manually create)
P.P5_backup_plan: If suggestion algorithm unavailable: show 'try again' message. If school enrollment fails: skip parent-community suggestions. If evacuation convoy fails: create manual routing UI for admins. If geo boundary missing: use radius-based fallback.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate suggestion failure (mock group query). Test with missing geo boundaries. Test evacuation convoy creation failure. Test with incomplete school enrollment data. Test edge cases: user at boundary of multiple groups, competing group types.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for group type classification logic. Integration tests for suggestion ranking (verify order). Load tests for evacuation convoy generation (1000+ users). Geo boundary accuracy tests (verify users in correct groups). Burn-together algorithm tests (verify scoring). End-to-end tests for full discovery and join flow.
P.P8_benchmarks: Group suggestions: <500ms for 50 nearby groups. Burn-together scoring: <2s for 100 candidates. Evacuation convoy creation: <10s for 1000 users. Suggestion relevance: top-3 suggestions ranked within user's primary needs 95% of time. False positive (wrong group suggested): <5%.

CH1_change_log.description: Initial CONFolder for group types module

L.L1_legal_considerations: Geo-boundary-based grouping may reveal user location (inferred from group membership). Mitigation: group membership is semi-public (members see each other). Evacuation convoys require legal authority (emergency declaration). Parent-community groups use school enrollment (FERPA concerns if school data mishandled).
L.L3_consent_requirements: User implicitly consents to location-based grouping by sharing location. Evacuation convoy participation is opt-in (during active event). Parent-community groups are opt-in (no forced joining).
L.L4_liability_notes: Evacuation convoy accuracy is critical (incorrect routing could lead to harm). Mitigation: convoy creation verified by fire/EMS, users can override routing. Parent-community group accuracy relies on school enrollment (if enrollment is wrong, wrong groups created). Mitigation: user can report incorrect enrollment.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Geo-boundary data: ~10MB for US (census tracts, fire districts). Suggestion queries: low compute cost (indexed). Burn-together algorithm: variable cost (complexity grows with candidate pool). Evacuation convoy generation: high compute during events (only during crises, acceptable spike).
F.F2_accounting_considerations: Geo-boundary data is one-time cost + periodic updates. Suggestion queries are operational cost (low). Evacuation convoy is event-triggered cost (unpredictable spike).
F.F3_revenue_impact: Auto-group creation drives adoption (reduces friction). Parent-community groups enable school-based engagement (retention). Burn-together groups enable wildfire preparedness (brand value). Evacuation convoys are critical capability (adoption driver).

S.S1_cybersecurity: Geo-boundary data is public (census tracts are public). Evacuation zone queries require authentication (user_id). Suggestion algorithm doesn't leak individual user locations (aggregates before returning). Burn-together algorithm uses only public hazard data.
S.S2_data_privacy: Group membership is semi-public within group (members see each other). Location can be inferred from neighborhood group membership (acceptable: neighborhood groups are opt-in). School enrollment data handled per FERPA.
S.S3_encryption_requirements: Evacuation convoy routes encrypted in transit (TLS). Burn-together hazard data not encrypted (public).
S.S4_access_control: Suggestion algorithm visible to authenticated users only. Geo-boundary data queries authenticated. Evacuation convoys only visible to members during event.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Log group creation (system-generated vs user-initiated). Log evacuation convoy generation (time, affected users). Audit trail retention: 1 year (longer for events).

X.X1_notes: Group types are multi-level: (1) automatic discovery (neighborhood, parent-community), (2) algorithmic matching (burn-together), (3) emergency auto-creation (evacuation convoy). Each type serves different user need. Integration with external data (census, school enrollment, hazard zones) is critical. Evacuation convoys are new capability (field testing needed).
